_note: App-level tunables (guidelines §7.2). Not game terms and not secrets: where files land, which ports the local UI uses, and which optional subsystems are on. Nothing here is negotiated with an opponent — the agreed terms live in game.json and the private per-peer settings in <role>/game.toml.

ui._note: Loopback by design. The dashboard shows OUR belief and our sealed state; exposing it would hand an opponent everything commit-reveal exists to hide (book rules 8-9).
ui._host_note: Honoured since T-2533; before that nothing read it and the bind was hard-coded, so editing this key did nothing. Prefer the per-run flag over changing it here: `--dashboard-host 0.0.0.0` reaches the panel from a Windows browser when WSL2 localhost forwarding is not working, without touching a tracked file — the same trade `--group-id` makes. A test pins this value at 127.0.0.1 because the panel renders our belief grid and sealed state (rules 8-9); leaving loopback by either route is announced as `dashboard.not_loopback` in the event log.

paths._counted_games_note: The counted-match ledger (rules 37-38). State we accumulate, not a setting: the figure is declared to every opponent at match start and a false declaration found at project review disqualifies the team, so it is derived from this file and never typed. Under workspace/ because editing it by hand is precisely the failure the rule names.

features._note: Both are off-by-default at the CLI (--tunnel/--dashboard); these are the values used when nothing is passed.
features._controls_note: Dashboard write actions (start/stop serving, approve terms). Off by default: a disabled write path is one fewer thing to reason about on match day. Playing a counted match is never a button — see src/najamjad_agent/ui/controls.py.

llm._note: Vendor endpoint. A provider moving its API is a config change, not a code change.

practice._note: Practice mode: the full pipeline runs and the report is really sent, but to redirect_to instead of the lecturer. The sender refuses to deliver anywhere else while this is on, so a broken redirect fails loudly rather than mailing a rehearsal to the grader. Off is the default and the only safe one.
